notes.title: NEW GAME: SHATTERED HEAVEN
notes.content:
Hi, I'm Giacomo Masi, creative director of Dry Drowning.

First of all I want to thank with all my heart every single player who decided to roam through the streets of Nova Polemos. Mordred, Hera, Freya and every other character within Dry Drowning would have been just an empty shell without all the affection that came from all the players.

The reason why I reached out to everyone today is because I'm really proud to announce that on the 31st of May we will finally release our new game, [b]Shattered heaven[/b], in early access. This time we delved into the[b] roguelite/rpg[/b] genre but of course we kept the multi branching/multi ending approach that we added in our previous title!

Please consider adding Shattered Heaven to your Wishlist and don't forget that a playable demo (with 2 hours of free content!) it's already available on Steam!

I can't wait to hear your feedback and I hope you will join us in this new adventure as well!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1454000/Shattered_Heaven/

[previewyoutube=gKV-wYzsQK4;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]MAIN FEATURES:[/b][/u]
[list][*] [b]A party of 3 unique characters[/b], each with their own customizable battle decks, skills and abilities.

[*] Explore a rich world filled with lore, discover challenging dungeons in the [b]4 main locations[/b] of the game.

[*] Fight your way through [b]dozens of unique enemies and formidable bosses[/b]!

[*] Collect Hero Cards and take advantage of Neutral Cards! [b]100+ unique cards await you[/b]!

[*] [u][b]STORY MODE[/b][/u]: experience the [b]multi-branching story of Shattered Heaven[/b] - take part in the War of the Ascension, meet a unique and captivating cast of characters and shape the destiny of the nameless world.

[*] [u][b]ROGUE-LIKE MODE[/b][/u]: not interested in the story? seeking a new challenge? This game mode is what you are looking for. 
Dive deep into the gameplay of Shattered Heaven, and force your way through [b]increasingly harder dungeons[/b]! Survive against hordes of enemies using your skill and knowledge!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35102369/2f79444ee5bc185764b69dd9e76cccf1cf567a89.jpg[/img]

notes.title: ANNOUNCING: SHATTERED HEAVEN
notes.content:
Dear citizens of Nova Polemos, we are here today to share an exciting announcement with you all!

[u][b]We can finally reveal our next title: SHATTERED HEAVEN![/b][/u]

[previewyoutube=ZuYeRij0AtU;full][/previewyoutube]
[b]Shattered Heaven is our new RPG, featuring deck-building and roguelite elements.[/b]

[i]Set in a nameless world, the game follows the tale of Andora, the Vestal of Ashram, and her guardians Magni and Ishana.
Follow the tale of our heroes as they undertake a series of deadly challenges in the hope of saving their people, and discover the truth behind this broken world covered in ashes.
Vanquish terrible foes, explore deadly dungeons and shape your own path to the end - three different endings await you![/i]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1454000/Shattered_Heaven/

After completing Dry Drowning, we set out with a clear objective in mind.
We wanted to create a brand new adventure that would feel extremely distinct from the story of Mordred Foley, while [b]keeping storytelling and world-building as one of our main pillars.[/b]

Thus, Shattered Heaven was born!
Inspired by our love of gritty fantasy, RPGs and card games, [b]the game is set to release in Early Access this October.[/b]

[previewyoutube=vQ4FEooQ0eQ;full][/previewyoutube]

[u][b]MAIN FEATURES:[/b][/u]

[list]
[*] [b]A party of 3 unique characters[/b], each with their own customizable battle decks, skills and abilities.

[*] Explore a rich world filled with lore, discover challenging dungeons in the [b]4 main locations[/b] of the game.

[*] Fight your way through [b]dozens of unique enemies and formidable bosses[/b]!

[*] Collect Hero Cards and take advantage of Neutral Cards! [b]100+ unique cards await you[/b]!

[*] [u][b]STORY MODE[/b][/u]: experience the [b]multi-branching story of Shattered Heaven[/b] - take part in the War of the Ascension, meet a unique and captivating cast of characters and shape the destiny of the nameless world.

[*] [u][b]ROGUE-LIKE MODE[/b][/u]: not interested in the story? seeking a new challenge? This game mode is what you are looking for. 
Dive deep into the gameplay of Shattered Heaven, and force your way through [b]increasingly harder dungeons[/b]! Survive against hordes of enemies using your skill and knowledge!
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/35102369/e8362fac197414bed60857e96328aa57e26d77d2.jpg[/img]

We also launched [b]a Kickstarter campaign that will allow us to implement even more features[/b].
We reached our goal of 20.000€ in less than 4 days!
More cards, enemies, bosses and events are going to be implemented during early access!

[u][b]Check out our Kickstarter campaign for exclusive rewards, and help us reach our Stretch Goals![/b][/u]
[url=https://www.kickstarter.com/projects/1355514053/shattered-heaven]SHATTERED HEAVEN KICKSTARTER[/url]



We’re excited to share even more news about Shattered Heaven, so follow us on our steam page and on Twitter! 
[url=https://twitter.com/PlayShattered]FOLLOW US ON TWITTER[/url]

[b]And don't forget to add Shattered Heaven in your Wishlist[/b]!
We hope to see you soon in the Nameless World, citizens of Nova Polemos!

notes.title: Dry Drowning - The first Major Update is available for download!
notes.content:
Dear Citizen,
as we had previously promised you we are finally ready to reveal the news related to the major update of Dry Drowning. Here are some of the most important features introduced: 

- Completely remade UI graphics with easier and snappier navigation.
- Added the ability to interact with AquaOS at any time.
- Added full controllers and keyboard support.
- New sound effects, UI animations and 3D elements.
- Added Korean language.

We work with passion and love to offer you the best possible result from our products. See you soon for more news, have fun and let us know what you think of these news. notes.title: Welcome to the darker side of Renaissance
notes.content:
[b]Our publisher VLG and our development team Studio V are thrilled to finally unveil their latest project, a bloody new historical epic called DARK RENAISSANCE[/b]

[previewyoutube=wTF7PLeab0c;full][/previewyoutube]

Penned by the acclaimed international bestselling author Matteo Strukul and scored by the award-winning composer David Logan, the title blends RPGs, period pieces and graphic novels together to depict the adventures of a Venetian mercenary who must uncover the shocking secrets hidden behind the scientific, artistic and cultural achievements of the 15th century Renaissance. 

The game is set to release in 2021.

Learn more 👉 http://dark-renaissance.com/

notes.title: BUILD 1.0.2 - PATCH NOTES
notes.content:
Dear citizens of Nova Polemos! 

Based on the feedback we collected from all of you, we implemented the following improvements and fixes in the current patch (Build 1.0.2):

[list]
[*] Added text related “Advancement mode” in Settings menu, featuring three dialogue modes:
[list]
[*] NORMAL: The text appears on the screen gradually. The player needs to click to advance to the next dialogue.
[*] FAST: The text appears on the screen all at once. The player needs to click to advance to the next dialogue.
[*] AUTO: The text appears on the screen gradually and automatically. The player doesn't need to click advance to the next dialogue.
[/list]

[*] Changes to investigation mode: It’s no longer possible to interact with the same area/object more than once.

[*] Modified the mouse cursor: The mouse pointer is less invasive during the non-investigative phases.

[*] Improved English localization of Chapter 1.

[*] [Bug Fix] Fixed an issue with the animations of Mordred and Hera’s portraits during the investigation in the “Darkroom” - Chapter 3.

[*] [Bug Fix] Fixed an issue with the animation of Abigail’s portrait in the following locations: “Foley Investigations”, “David Casey’s Office”, “Talon Square”.

[*] [Bug Fix] Minor fixes to text formatting.

[*] [Bug Fix] Several timing adjustments during dialogues and cut scenes.
[/list]

That's all for now, we hope you'll enjoy the changes we made! 
Meanwhile our dev team is already working on further improvements. 

Stay tuned and [u]Be a Good Citizen[/u]!

Tormented by a past of accusations, failures and unsolved murders, he will have to deal with the return of a ruthless serial killer. On his side he'll have few allies to trust, but the most precious, his investigative instinct, is able to show him in a grotesque way when someone is lying.


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1077970/Dry_Drowning/

notes.title: WELCOME TO NOVA POLEMOS
notes.content:
[b]The shadows of Dry Drowning, our upcoming visual novel, are coming to haunt your dreams.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35102369/fe7a86ea5df611c8b65485dabb2d9a3e0f19983c.jpg[/img]

In Nova Polemos, once a beautiful and modern city, there’s only room for corruption and desperation. You are just a number, a minor cog in the death machine, yet you might be the only hope to bring light in the darkness. 

It’s only up to you. 

[b]But remember: the truth is... you can’t trust anyone. Not even yourself.[/b]

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/35102369/410c0ca925968a27315062ece5767f26dcfab1c2.png[/img]

A shady socio-political situation dragging everything down to the abyss, a serial killer drawing strength from this darkness, a tormented detective and his assistant craving for redemption. 

An old case still knocking on the door and a broken man willing to do whatever it takes to bring his archenemy to justice, even cutting ambiguous deals and becoming a demon himself...


https://store.steampowered.com/app/1077970
